name: Macaroni Salad
description: A classic macaroni salad with tuna, ham, and cheddar cheese, mixed with Miracle Whip and spices.

recipeInstructions.text: Cook macaroni according to package directions. Let cool.
Cut up celery, cheese, tuna, and ham into small pieces.
Combine cooled macaroni with the tuna mixture.
Add enough Miracle Whip to moisten the salad.
Sprinkle with parsley flakes and paprika.
Mix well and serve.

keywords: macaroni salad, tuna salad, cheddar cheese

_similar.name: Sauerkraut Salad
_similar.description: A tangy and crunchy salad featuring sauerkraut, chopped vegetables, and a sweet-and-sour dressing that keeps well in the refrigerator.
recipeIngredient: 1 (28 oz) jar or can sauerkraut, drained

recipeInstructions.text: Heat the vinegar, sugar, and salt in a saucepan until boiling.
Let the dressing cool to room temperature.
In a large bowl, combine the drained sauerkraut, chopped celery, onion, red pepper, and green pepper.
Pour the cooled dressing over the salad and toss to coat.
Store in a sealed container in the refrigerator for up to 2-3 weeks.

_similar.keywords: sauerkraut salad, tangy salad, make-ahead salad

_similar.name: Macaroni Ham Casserole
_similar.description: A comforting macaroni and ham casserole topped with cheddar cheese and crushed sour cream and onion potato chips.
recipeIngredient: 1 to 1¼ cups (250 to 375 mL) grated cheddar cheese
Crushed sour cream and onion flavoured potato chips for topping

recipeInstructions.text: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Cook the macaroni in boiling water, then drain and mix in cubed ham.
Melt margarine in a saucepan and mix in the flour. Add in the milk and stir constantly over medium heat until the mixture is thick and smooth.
Mix the sauce with the macaroni and ham, then pour into a greased casserole dish.
Add salt and pepper to taste, and stir in about ¾ of the grated cheddar cheese.
Sprinkle the remaining cheddar cheese on top.
Top with crushed sour cream and onion flavoured potato chips.
Bake at 350°F for approximately 20 minutes, or until the casserole is bubbling.

_similar.keywords: macaroni casserole, ham and cheese, comfort food

_similar.name: Cheese Ball
_similar.description: A classic cheese ball made with grated cheese, Cheez Whiz, and deviled ham, perfect for a quick appetizer.
recipeIngredient: Chopped pecans or parsley flakes for coating

recipeInstructions.text: Beat all ingredients in a mixer until creamed.
Form into 2 balls and wrap in Saran Wrap.
Refrigerate until firm.
Roll into chopped pecans or parsley flakes to coat.

_similar.keywords: cheese ball, party appetizer, easy snack

_similar.name: Creamy Broccoli Soup
_similar.description: A creamy and comforting broccoli soup made with potatoes, chicken broth, and a touch of Miracle Whip for richness.

recipeInstructions.text: In a large saucepan, bring chicken broth to a boil. Add potatoes and broccoli. Simmer for 10 minutes or until tender.
Purée the mixture in a blender until smooth.
Pour the puréed mixture back into the saucepan. Using a whisk, blend in Miracle Whip and seasonings.
Heat the soup thoroughly, stirring occasionally, until warmed through. Serve hot.

_similar.keywords: creamy broccoli soup, potato soup, comforting soup

_similar.name: Cheese & Broccoli Soup
_similar.description: A creamy broccoli and cheese soup with a rich, velvety texture.

recipeInstructions.text: Melt butter in a large saucepan.
Cook onions until tender; do not brown.
Add chicken stock and broccoli; bring to a boil.
Whisk in flour and cook for 3 minutes.
Return to heat; cook and stir until mixture thickens.
Reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes; do not boil.
Puree mixture until smooth.
Heat through with milk, cheese, and seasonings.

_similar.keywords: broccoli soup, cheese soup, creamy soup
